scope: Parsing, formatting and stepping (dom/number.ts), the resolver, and the web component in happy-dom: anatomy, ARIA, typing, commit (clamp, snap, reformat), keys, steppers (press and hold), scrub, wheel, validity, reset, adornments, authored parts and events; the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), its markup parity with the web component and the compound parts. Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: locale parsing and formatNumber display, stepping (snap, clamp, float noise, modifiers), the resolver; anatomy, ARIA, recipe classes, no native form elements, typing and commit reasons, keys, steppers, press and hold, scrub, wheel, snap-on-step, allow-out-of-range, required, reset, adornments, authored parts

SSR markup against the web component (parts, classes, host data-*, formatted text, input mode), the hidden form input, compound parts against the preset, render and className functions, parts outside the Root

limitations: Geometry review (manual, 2026-11-02, Chromium): apps/studio/geometry-check.html checks the group height (8u), padding (u − B), radius, font, stepper size (6u), glyph (icon size sm), stepper radius (R − u) and insets, the input's 1u text inset beside each stepper and 0.5u beside a prefix or suffix, the slot-high input and the 1.5u label gap at every size × B 0 and 1 ("fails": []). Growth: at u = 2 a long label wraps above the 16px group (steppers stay 12px); in a 120px column the steppers keep 6u and the text scrolls inside the input (no overflow of the group). RTL: the group mirrors (decrement and prefix at the inline start, on the right) (the scrub direction reads the computed direction; not probed by pointer in RTL). Focus: the 2px ring is an outline on the group, so its box is unchanged. Real Chromium input: typing refuses letters, Arrow Up / Shift+Arrow Up step 1 / 10, a 700 ms hold repeats (1 + 5 steps), a 40px scrub steps 20 (pixel-sensitivity 2) with data-scrubbing. Screenshots: the Entry family (#/components?family=entry), light and dark, ladder 3, 4, 4.5 (theme) and 6.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React NumberField with ui-number-field at five sizes, and the composed parts with the preset ("fails": []).
Not implemented: Base UI's ScrubAreaCursor and pointer lock (the system cursor stays; a scrub stops at the screen edge).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
